games.description: A solo roadside horror trip. Sark repairs a broken car while sheltering from oily creatures, follows a surreal route through car-centered landscapes, and reaches an unexpectedly loud final confrontation.
games.title: AUTO-CRISIS

games.description: A completed solo escape from a cannibal asylum. Sark manages dangerous flatulence, finds the infirmary and chapel keys, battles cultists with a revolver and crowbar, and retries the final axe-wielding leader until the captives are freed.
games.title: Fartal Error

games.description: Sark uses chat votes to guide a father and baby through a dangerous cinema bathroom encounter. Replays explore fatal choices, an avoided encounter and a surviving-son ending.
games.title: Purple Maniac

games.description: Sark climbs an anomaly-filled stairwell, memorizes its statues, fans and windows, and completes a run before checking the remaining nightmare and difficulty challenges.
